description: Chapter 3 travel-task scenarios. Each request states constraints (route, date, nonstop, budget, rating, activity type/count) that vague genesis tool descriptions cause the agent to miss. The deterministic check scores the booked TripState against `constraints`.

scenarios.request: Book me the cheapest nonstop flight from SFO to JFK on 2026-06-15, and keep it under $450.
Plan a New York trip: a nonstop SFO to JFK flight on 2026-06-15, plus a hotel rated 4 stars or better, under $300 a night, for 3 nights.
Put together a New York weekend: a nonstop flight SFO to JFK on 2026-06-15, a 4-star-or-better hotel under $300 a night for 2 nights, and two food activities.
Cheap Los Angeles trip: the cheapest nonstop SFO to LAX flight on 2026-06-15 and a hotel under $200 a night for 2 nights.
From Seattle: book a nonstop SEA to JFK flight on 2026-06-15 under $450, a hotel rated 4 stars or better, and one museum activity.
